senses.sense_definition: A flighty person who is considered silly, irresponsible, or scatterbrained, often prone to excessive chatting or gossiping.

examples.text: She was dismissed as a mere <w>flibbertigibbet</w> who could not focus on her professional duties.
The manager grew tired of the <w>flibbertigibbet</w> constantly gossiping instead of finishing the report.

senses.sense_definition: An offbeat, skittish, or restless person, particularly used to describe a young woman.

examples.text: The young <w>flibbertigibbet</w> danced around the room without a care in the world.
He found her skittish nature charming, though others called her a <w>flibbertigibbet</w>.

senses.sense_definition: A mischievous imp or a fiend.

examples.text: The old folklore described the creature as a tiny <w>flibbertigibbet</w> causing chaos in the kitchen.
In the story, the <w>flibbertigibbet</w> hid all the keys to prevent the travelers from leaving.

traits.comment: Used in older literature or folklore contexts.
